title: Semi-Tensor Product-Based Multi-Term Randomized T-SVD and Its Visual Applications
abstract: arXiv:2609.11168v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tensor singular value decomposition (T-SVD), which is built upon the tensor-tensor product (t-product), has emerged as a powerful tool for processing high-dimensional visual data such as color images and videos. However, the standard t-product imposes strict dimensional compatibility constraints. Although extensions based on the semi-tensor product (STP) relax this restriction, their single-term formulations still suffer from limited approximation accuracy. Moreover, these deterministic methods incur high computational costs when processing large-scale tensor data. To address these issues, this paper introduces a novel semi-tensor product for third-order tensors under the t-product framework induced by arbitrary invertible linear transforms. translated_title: 基于半张量积的多项随机T-SVD及其视觉应用
translated_abstract: 张量奇异值分解建立在张量-张量积基础之上，已成为处理彩色图像和视频等高维视觉数据的有力工具。然而，标准t-product施加了严格的维度兼容性约束。尽管基于半张量积（STP）的扩展放宽了这一限制，但其单项式形式仍然存在近似精度有限的问题。此外，这些确定性方法在处理大规模张量数据时会带来较高的计算成本。为解决这些问题，本文在由任意可逆线性变换诱导的t-product框架下，为三阶张量引入了一种新颖的半张量积。由此得到的张量半张量积打破了标准t-product的严格维度匹配要求，同时保留了T-SVD的闭式特性。基于这一构造，我们……
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于新型半张量积的多项随机T-SVD方法，突破了标准t-product的维度匹配限制，同时保留T-SVD的闭式特性，提升了近似精度并降低了大规模视觉数据处理的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-term randomized T-SVD based on a novel semi-tensor product, which breaks the dimensional matching constraints of the standard t-product while retaining the closed-form property of T-SVD, thereby improving approximation accuracy and reducing computational costs for large-scale visual data processing.
